idea-plugin.name: Flagsmith Feature Flags
idea-plugin.description:
Flagsmith Feature Flags is an unofficial community plugin that brings your Flagsmith flags and experiments into JetBrains IDEs.

Browse, search, and toggle feature flags from a sidebar tool window. Open the Experiments tab to inspect Flagsmith experiments — hypothesis, variants, metrics, rollout, and trait-based A/B results. Your Organisation API key is stored in the IDE password safe, not in project files.

Works with self-hosted Flagsmith and with Flagsmith Cloud. Built against the open source Flagsmith API.

This plugin is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially supported by Flagsmith.

  • Flags tool window: search, toggle, create, and edit flags
  • In-editor gutters, completion, and an unknown-flag inspection for JS/TS
  • Experiments tab: list experiments, view results, and start, pause, or complete them
  • Settings under Settings | Tools | Flagsmith
